records.subject: Checking in on Timber Studio's setup
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Wanted to check whether the onboarding made sense or whether anything got in the way. No action needed if everything's going smoothly.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Timber Studio* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer reply to three outreaches (email:4d03c82b, email:6d3a9352, email:5ab0ca4c). A getting started call was held (calendar:fec65503) yet nothing followed in 2+ days, suggesting low engagement; some chance Sam acts within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One next step for Timber Studio
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on, so just one note: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first project in place is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
